content.purpose: Topics need to nest, peer, contradict, and reference each other. A flat list of topics gives you tagging — it doesn't give you a lattice. This vocab makes the lattice first-class: you can ask 'show me all narrower topics under Roswell Incident' and the substrate walks the edges to deliver. Federation: a node sharing its 'Roswell Incident' topic also exports its topic relations, so the receiving node knows what's a parent, what's a peer, what's an explanation.
content.scope_distinction: edgevocab governs entity↔entity relations and node↔node general edges. topicvocab governs ONLY topic↔topic relations and adds topic-specific metadata fields (temporal_span, concept/instance kind). The two vocabularies don't overlap.
content.ldu_relationship: Inferred topic relations (auto-cluster proposes 'topic A narrower_than topic B' from member-subset detection) land in LDU staging with confidence < 1.0 and a 'proposed_by' attribution. Promotion to GDU requires either (a) high-confidence auto-approval per relation type, or (b) user confirmation.
content.federation_relationship: When two nodes' assertions about the same topic merge, their topic relations also merge via union. If node A says 'Roswell Incident narrower_than UFO Crash Retrievals' and node B doesn't have the parent topic, B receives the parent admission as part of the merge.
